providers.name: CommunicationSourceAdapter
providers.rule: adapter never returns mutable external handles to domain code; source is opened read-only and transient content is discarded unless accepted retention criteria are met

providers.name: TicketCommunicationIdentityProvider
providers.rule: only accepted official SR/RFC identities and retained aliases are trackable; descriptive text/device/customer/contact data never satisfies the gate

providers.name: TaskObjectiveCommunicationIdentityProvider
providers.rule: WFM accepted identity and explicitly exported Objective communication reference may be trackable; Local Task without accepted external communication identifier is not

providers.name: InventoryCommunicationIdentityProvider
providers.rule: closed target set is SPARE_REQUEST,RMA,FAULT_TAG and uses current accepted identifiers/aliases from Inventory authority

providers.name: ContactCommunicationLookupProvider
providers.rule: participant names/addresses never prove Contact identity; Contact relation remains optional reviewed metadata

providers.name: CommunicationProposalContractRegistry
providers.rule: static release registry only; COMM_LINK_V1 is LLD-09-owned and every domain-fact contract/version is explicitly registered to exactly one owning packet with a StrictVersionedJson schema; no runtime plugin/dynamic contract registration

providers.name: CommunicationProposalEvidenceProvider
providers.rule: owning domain uses exact immutable communication/link/source evidence; provider exposes no raw external handle

providers.name: CommunicationProposalDispositionParticipant
providers.rule: called inside owning-domain command UnitOfWork after fresh validation; creates no nested receipt/commit

providers.name: ServiceRequestTerminalCommunicationParticipant
providers.rule: freezes SR summary, closes only SR direct links and starts/cancels orphan grace in caller UoW; post-purge reversal queues bounded targeted backfill after commit when source is available

providers.name: RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant
providers.rule: proposal_snapshot is exact LLD-03 RfcTerminalCascadeProposalSnapshotV1. Preview is read-only and returns only COMMUNICATIONS impact kinds RFC_TERMINAL_SUMMARY_FREEZE, RFC_DIRECT_LINK_CLOSE and ORPHAN_GRACE_EVALUATION under the LLD-03 RfcTerminalCascadeImpactProviderPageV1 contract; provider_fingerprint binds the complete ordered impact set plus authoritative link/hold/retention revisions, not just the page. revalidate uses that exact complete impact/fingerprint authority inside the caller LLD-03 writer UnitOfWork, exact-compares reviewed_exact_count/reviewed_provider_fingerprint, returns only READY|STALE|INDETERMINATE, emits no impact page and mutates nothing. apply owns Communication links/frozen summary/orphan grace in that same caller UoW only after LLD-03 has both cross-domain revalidations READY, commits nothing independently, and accepted terminal evidence or a merely pending proposal never calls apply

providers.name: CommunicationSummaryProvider
providers.rule: read-only projection consumed by LLD-11 and other summary consumers; counts derive from surviving accepted links and canonical communications, never drafts/rejected links

providers.name: CommunicationPanelProjectionProvider
providers.rule: exact read-only workbench contract consumed by LLD-10; composes CommunicationSummaryProvider plus the same canonical keyset message projection used by ListCommunications and never stores a second body/count authority

providers.name: AuditWriter
providers.method: append required LLD-09 registered audit action inside caller UnitOfWork

providers.name: DurableJobCoordinator
methods: enqueue/coalesce/cancel/recover registered LLD09 job types under jobs/communication-jobs.json

providers.name: DeliberateActionProofProvider
providers.rule: LLD-09 consumes this only for explicit Deep Scan; proof is single-use/session-run-bound friction evidence and never replaces source/coverage/business revalidation

providers.name: DiagnosticSink
providers.method: emit sanitized LLD09 DiagnosticEventV1 -> best-effort result

cross_packet_rules: LLD-09 owns source scopes, canonical communications, links, proposal evidence/disposition, coverage, message-content retention, orphan purge, MSG draft provenance and communication summaries.
LLD-09 never changes SR/RFC/WFM/Task/Objective/Inventory lifecycle state; owner commands consume proposal evidence and return result references through the disposition participant.

LLD-03 owns the RFC terminal-cascade orchestration snapshot/impact envelope; LLD-09 supplies only its exact Communications-domain impact page/fingerprint and same-UoW complete-set revalidation through that static contract.
LLD-10 consumes CommunicationPanelProjectionProvider; LLD-11 consumes CommunicationSummaryProvider. Neither stores a competing authoritative communication body/count.

All same-UoW participants use one caller command receipt and never commit/rollback independently. RFC terminal-cascade revalidation is read-only inside that same writer transaction and precedes deliberate-proof consumption/apply.
Proposal contract registration is build-time/static authority only; a parser, message body or runtime extension cannot invent a new owning-domain mutation kind.
Deep Scan deliberate-action proof is supplied and consumed through LLD-12; LLD-09 stores no proof/session secret.
